en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Couplets on the Taints and Association with Taints (Āsava-āsava-sampayutta-duka).

Dependent on a dhamma that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, and which is both an *āsava* and associated with an *āsava*, there arises, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*), a dhamma that is neither demonstrable nor reactive and is neither an *āsava* nor dissociated from an *āsava*. Dependent on a dhamma that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive,
and which is both an *āsava* and associated with an *āsava*, [there arises] a dhamma that is neither non-demonstrable nor reactive and is neither an *āsava*...
A state that is neither an outflow nor dissociated from outflows arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, which is both an outflow and associated with outflows,
there arise states that are neither demonstrable nor reactive, and are neither outflows nor dissociated from outflows, by way of the root condition.
(Condensed. With respect to root-cause, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible and non-reacting, associated with the taints (*āsava*) and not itself a taint, there arises a state that is neither visible nor reacting, dissociated from the taints and not itself a taint, by way of the root-cause condition. (Condensed.)
With respect to the root condition, three; ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.
